finding.text: Web dictation was not wired, and that is step 4 itself. The plan card (/live/plan/one-refiner/, steps 4 and 6) says web dictation calls `Ask.write` "then the refiner" (the parts brief), and Echo's clean/structure is the duplicate that gets moved aside. The work calls `Sessions.refine` (`Servex/agents/Sessions.js:947`, Echo clean + structure) good enough, so there are now two refiners after `Ask.write`: parts for voice and VS Code, and Echo structure for dictation and VS Code. The brief says "never a second refiner". `TurnRefiner.refine` should run after `Sessions.js:1304` too, or the log should say why not.

Nobody proved web dictation gets cited. Deliverable 2 asks for a real turn with `coverage().cited > 0` on any channel, but the only proof is the cloud-voice scratch turn (0 to 4 of 4, logged in session.jsonl). It was a temporary proof.mjs that the task folder does not keep.

Deliverable 3 (the view) is not done. There is no 1200 shot; the one shot, `shots/session-a943a876-400.png` (it sits only in the worktree), shows no Coverage line; and nothing says whether the "Reading the session…" stall is slow loading or a bug. The log names a suspect (`AISessionDetail.js:365`, the stats bar waits for `work_ready`) but has no timing measurement. The brief asked for that answer first.

The task was never landed. session.jsonl ends with "session ended (other) without landing", so it has no closing outcome. The report the brief asked for (three lines: what was missing, what was wired at file:line, coverage before and after) is only inside one long log line, and a fresh agent can't continue deliverable 3 from this folder.

Stale and unindexed docs. `Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md` still describes the voice record as words plus sentences, with no refiner. `Servex/agents/readme.md` does not list `TurnRefiner.js` or its test. Law 9 asks for the structure in the readme, and law 10 for an index entry for each new file.

`TurnRefiner` runs one Sonnet call (claude.exe) per voice turn with no switch. Unlike `PromptTasks` (`prompt-tasks.off`) and `Echo.call` (the free-memory floor, `Echo.js:124`), it can't be turned off and skips the memory check. Worth a one-line gate that reuses `PromptTasks.off()`.

`TurnRefiner` is the generic "refine after `Ask.write`" step, not a Servex agent. It could sit beside `Server/Ask.mjs` (for example as `Server/TurnRefiner.mjs`), where every channel, including the hook, could import it. The `parts_of` split in `Server/PromptRecords.mjs:148` is clean and reuses the one brief.

The code itself is sound. `TurnRefiner.test.mjs` passes in under 1 s. The second `refined` line (v 2, same `re`) fills the existing turn (`Session.js:181`), and its 1-based cites line up with `a<n>`. A Servex restart is needed before the cloud-voice change goes live.
